Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics; if you have renal failure; if you have moist skin, severe erosion, deep wounds, severe burns, or a severe condition with a hard lump; if you have suppurative dermatitis; if the affected area is extensive; or if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If the symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use or become worse, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or lukewarm water. Be careful not to let it touch skin other than the area being treated.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 만 12개월 미만의 젖먹이, 심한 증상의 신부전: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, nursing infants under 12 months of age, and patients with severe renal failure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have hyperoxaluria; if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; if the user is a premature infant or a young child; if you have cardiac and circulatory system dysfunction, renal impairment, hypoproteinemia, gout, or kidney stones; if you have experienced hypersensitivity or allergic reactions to Yellow No. 5; or if you have folic acid deficiency. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. It may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests, and it may turn the urine yellow and thereby affect clinical test values. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 만 3개월 미만의 영아 및 만 2세 미만의 소아,: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, infants under 3 months of age and children under 2 years of age, and people who are taking an MAO inhibitor (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of stopping one must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic constitution or have experienced allergic symptoms to medicines (e.g. fever, rash, joint pain, itching, etc.); if you have liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), or difficulty urinating; if you are elderly, frail, or have a high fever; if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; or if you smoke or have asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts or recurs for 1 week or more, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 상처 또는 염증이 있는 두피 및 심한 미란(짓무름: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use it, and it must not be used on a scalp with wounds or inflammation or on areas with severe erosion. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액 이상 환자, 심한 간장애,: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver impairment, severe kidney impairment, or severely reduced cardiac function, patients with aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks triggered by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) or a history of it, patients who have taken barbiturates or tricyclic antidepressants, and people who have consumed alcohol must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have liver impairment or kidney impairment, a history of peptic ulcer, blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency, or abnormal cardiac function; if you have experienced hypersensitivity; if you have bronchial asthma; if you are elderly; if the user is a child under 2 years of age; or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Without instructions from a doctor or pharmacist, do not take it for pain for more than 10 days (adults) or more than 5 days (children), and do not take it for fever for more than 3 days.

To prevent this medicine from spreading to other parts of the body or infecting other people, apply it while wearing a finger cot or rubber gloves.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 심한 신기능장애 또는 간기능장애 환자, 심근경색: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with severe renal or hepatic impairment, and patients who have or have had a myocardial infarction must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients who are hypersensitive to caramel, people with urinary retention (pooling of urine) problems, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and people who take it continuously for 15 days or more should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If abnormal symptoms appear from taking this medicine, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 알츠하이머병, 치질, 체액 저류(부기), 임신 중: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine and patients with Alzheimer's disease, hemorrhoids, fluid retention (swelling), toxemia of pregnancy, diarrhea, or undiagnosed gastrointestinal bleeding must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; if you have renal impairment; if you are physically frail or elderly; if you are on a low-phosphorus diet; if you have impaired digestion and absorption; or if you have symptoms of gastrointestinal bleeding such as vomiting of blood or black stools. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 염증성 장질환(궤양성 대장염, 크론병 등), 독성: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine and patients with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.), toxic megacolon, intestinal perforation or a risk of intestinal perforation, intestinal obstruction or suspected intestinal obstruction, intestinal stricture, abdominal pain of unknown cause, or fructose intolerance must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a child under 2 years of age; if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; if you have acute constipation not caused by a change in lifestyle habits, or acute constipation accompanied by pain, fever, or abdominal distension; if you have irritable bowel syndrome; or if you are hypersensitive to macrogol (polyethylene glycol) or sulfur dioxide.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 위장관궤양, 위장관 출혈 또는 경험자, 심한 혈액: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding or a history of them, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver impairment, severe kidney impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma or a history of it, patients who have hypersensitivity such as asthma, hives, or allergic reactions to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors) or a history of it, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, patients taking high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency, liver cirrhosis, liver impairment or a history of it, kidney impairment or a history of it, cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus or mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease; if the user is elderly or a child; if you are pregnant or breastfeeding; or if you are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약의 구성성분 또는 다른 해열진통제, 감기약: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking the ingredients of this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, and infants (newborns) under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, infants, and children must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or external genitalia, on eczema, on moist (damp) areas, on erosion, on diseased areas with severe cracking or wounds, on the nails, or on the scalp. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Clean the diseased area and its surroundings before use. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or warm water. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Use this medicine for external use only; do not take it internally.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기, 눈 또는 눈 주위에는 이 약을 사용하: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine and women in the 3rd trimester of pregnancy must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the 1st and 2nd trimesters), patients who are allergic to medicines or cosmetics or have been in the past, and people with severe moist skin or erosion should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the areas with acne or pimples, and do not use it on large surrounding areas, around the eyes, on deep wounds, or on severe burns. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. If it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or lukewarm water. If the irritation persists, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to let it touch skin other than the area being treated.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 피부감염증(결핵, 매독, 칸디다증, 백선, 대상포: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with skin infections (tuberculosis, syphilis, candidiasis, ringworm, shingles, chickenpox, vaccinia, scabies, pubic lice), patients with a damaged immune system (bone marrow transplantation or AIDS), patients with eczematous otitis externa with a perforated eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), burns and frostbite of deep second degree or worse, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris, or rosacea, breastfeeding women, children under 18 years of age, and patients who have or have had a myocardial infarction must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and elderly people should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Use it only on cold sores on the lips or around the mouth, and do not use it in the eyes, nose, mouth, or on the genitals. Do not use it on people who have no signs or symptoms. Do not use it for the purpose of preventing transmission to others or preventing recurrent herpes simplex infection. Do not use this medicine as a base for diluting it or mixing it with other medicines.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전에: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, and patients with uremia should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Dilute it before oral administration.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.눈 또는 눈주위, 점막: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Do not cover or wrap the treated area, and do not expose it to external heat or hot water. If water touches the area where this medicine has been used, you may feel strong irritation. Patients with particularly delicate skin must not use this medicine repeatedly on the same area. Do not use it for a long period.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. If the symptoms become worse or last for 3 days or more, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. Wash your hands thoroughly before use. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

entries.이 약에 과민증, 갑상선기능 이상 환자, 6세 미만의 소아, 방사성요오드: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with thyroid dysfunction, children under 6 years of age, and patients who are undergoing radioactive iodine therapy or are before or after such therapy must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with severe sores in the mouth and women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use it for the mouth only.

Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a nursing infant under 1 year of age, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or if the user is a premature infant or a young child. This medicine contains sodium benzoate, and benzoic acid can be a mild irritant to the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Take this medicine by mouth only; do not use it for injection. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 염증성 장질환 환자(궤양성 대장염, 크론병 등), 독성: People who are hypersensitive to this medicine and patients with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.), toxic megacolon, intestinal perforation, intestinal obstruction, intestinal stricture, or abdominal pain of unknown cause must not take this medicine. Do not give this medicine to children for more than 3 months.
entries.이 약에 포함된 성분에 과민반응이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용을 즉각 중: If a hypersensitivity reaction to an ingredient contained in this medicine occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약은 가려움, 벌레물린데, 두드러기, 땀띠, 옻 등에 의한 접촉피부염: This medicine is used for itching, insect bites, hives, prickly heat, contact dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, chilblains, eczema, dermatitis, and erosion.
entries.이 약은 감기로 인한 발열 및 동통(통증), 두통, 신경통, 근육통, 월: This medicine is used for fever and pain caused by colds, headache, neuralgia, muscle pain, menstrual pain, sprain pain, toothache, joint pain, and rheumatic pain.
entries.이 약은 감기의 여러 증상(인후통, 오한(춥고 떨리는 증상), 발열, 두: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (sore throat, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 감기의 제증상(여러증상)(콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후(목구멍): This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 감기의 제증상(콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후통, 가래, 오한,: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, phlegm, chills, fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 경구중독의 해독제로서 사용할 때, 약용탄과 이페칵(토근)시럽의: When this medicine is used as an antidote for oral poisoning, giving medicinal charcoal together with ipecac syrup is not recommended, because the ipecac syrup is adsorbed by the medicinal charcoal and vomiting is thereby prevented. If ipecac syrup and medicinal charcoal are used together, it is recommended that the medicinal charcoal be given after vomiting has been induced and completed. This medicine should be given after gastric aspiration or gastric lavage has been completed with the involvement of a doctor. Within 2 hours of giving medicinal charcoal, the charcoal adsorbs other medicines and therefore reduces their effect. This medicine may colour the stool black.

entries.이 약은 과음, 구역질(숙취, 악취로 인한 메슥거림), 구토, 식욕부진,: This medicine is used for excessive drinking, nausea (queasiness from a hangover or from bad smells), vomiting, loss of appetite, an uncomfortable stomach, a weak stomach, promotion of digestion, overeating, chest tightness, a feeling of stomach fullness caused by indigestion, and indigestion.
entries.이 약은 긁힌 상처, 베인 상처, 창상, 손 및 손가락의 살균과 소독,: This medicine is used for the sterilization and disinfection of scratches, cuts, and wounds and of the hands and fingers, and, in the case of hemorrhoids, for the sterilization and disinfection of the anus.
This medicine is used for cough, phlegm, runny nose, nasal congestion, and sneezing.
entries.이 약은 눈의 건조 또는 바람이나 태양에 노출되어 생기는 화끈거리는 증상: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of dryness of the eye or of the burning sensation, irritation, and discomfort caused by exposure to wind or sun.
entries.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로 사용합니다.어플리케이터의 포장을 벗기고 스: Use this medicine in the following order. Remove the applicator from its packaging and hold it with the sponge facing downwards. Do not touch the sponge part of the applicator. Squeeze the applicator firmly only once so that the ampoule breaks and the solution comes out, and leave the broken ampoule inside the applicator. For the 26 mL product, squeeze the lever on the handle firmly, and for the other products squeeze both wings firmly. Do not squeeze or press the wings repeatedly in order to wet the sponge quickly. Press and release the sponge against the treatment area until the solution is visible on the skin, wetting the sponge and completely wetting the treatment area with the solution. For a dry surgical site (e.g. the abdomen or an arm), once the solution is visible on the skin, rub gently back and forth for 30 seconds to treat that area. For a moist surgical site (e.g. the groin fold), rub gently back and forth repeatedly for about 2 minutes. Let the area to which the solution has been applied dry completely in the air, and do not wipe the solution off. Discard the applicator after a single use, together with any remaining solution that was not used on the treatment area. It is not necessary to use the entire amount.
entries.이 약은 류마티양 관절염, 연소성(어리거나 젊은나이에 나타나는) 류마티양: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis (occurring at a young age), osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), fever and pain caused by colds, back pain, dysmenorrhea, pain after surgery, ankylosing spondylitis, headache, toothache, muscle pain, neuralgia, acute gout, psoriatic arthritis, soft tissue injury (sprains, contusions), and non-articular rheumatic disease (tendinitis, tenosynovitis, bursitis).
entries.이 약은 멀미에 의한 어지러움·구토·두통 등의 예방 및 완화에 사용합니다: This medicine is used to prevent and relieve dizziness, vomiting, headache, and similar symptoms caused by motion sickness.
entries.이 약은 바람, 연기, 공해, 먼지, 건조한 열, 에어컨, 항공여행, 장: This medicine is used for dryness of the eye (discomfort, stinging pain, irritation) or eye fatigue caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel, or long hours of computer use.
entries.이 약은 변비, 만성변비, 영·유아 및 소아의 변비, 분만 후의 변비에: This medicine is used for constipation, chronic constipation, constipation in infants, young children and children, and constipation after childbirth.
entries.이 약은 변비와 변비에 수반하는 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부(배부분)팽만,: This medicine is used for constipation and for the relief of loss of appetite, abdominal distension, abnormal fermentation in the intestines, and hemorrhoids that accompany constipation.

entries.이 약은 설사, 소화기관내의 이상 발효에 의한 생성가스의 흡착 및 약물: This medicine is used for diarrhea, for the adsorption of gas produced by abnormal fermentation in the digestive tract, and as an adsorbent for emergency detoxification in cases of poisoning by medicines and chemicals.
entries.이 약은 소프트콘택트렌즈 또는 하드콘택트렌즈를 착용하고 있을 때의 불쾌감: This medicine is used for discomfort while wearing soft or hard contact lenses, for supplementing tears (dryness of the eye), for eye fatigue, and for blurred vision (when there is a lot of eye mucus).
entries.이 약은 수술전 환자의 피부소독, 주사기 바늘, 카테타 삽입 전 환자의: This medicine is used for disinfecting the patient's skin before surgery and for disinfecting the patient's skin before the insertion of a syringe needle or catheter.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 땀띠, 옻 등에 의한 피부염, 가려움, 벌레물림: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, prickly heat, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, itching, insect bites, hives, chilblains, and frostbite injuries.
entries.이 약은 식도미란의 영상을 저하시키므로, 만약 부식성 물질을 섭취하였을: Since this medicine impairs the imaging of esophageal erosion, do not take it if a corrosive substance has been ingested. Do not use this medicine in patients with diabetes without a doctor's diagnosis and prescription.
entries.이 약은 안구건조증 또는 바람이나 태양에 노출되거나 생기는 화끈거리는 증: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of dry eye syndrome or of the burning sensation, irritation, and discomfort caused by exposure to wind or sun, and for the prevention of irritation.
This medicine is used for acne.
entries.이 약은 영양부족으로 인한 각막, 결막의 궤양성 질환에 영양공급과 콘택트: This medicine is used to supply nutrition in ulcerative disorders of the cornea and conjunctiva caused by nutritional deficiency, and for micro-damage to the cornea and conjunctiva caused by wearing contact lenses and the like.
entries.이 약은 위산과다, 속쓰림, 소화불량, 위부불쾌감, 위부팽만감, 체함,: This medicine is used for excess stomach acid, heartburn, indigestion, stomach discomfort, a feeling of stomach fullness, upset stomach, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, acid belching, overeating, promotion of digestion, and loss of appetite.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 · 수유기, 병중 · 병후(병을 앓는 동안이나: This medicine is used to supply vitamins D, E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or during recovery), the growth period, and old age; to prevent poor development of the bones and teeth and rickets; to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), beriberi, and eye fatigue; to relieve angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation of the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis; and to supply zinc.

entries.이 약은 자양강장, 허약체질, 육체피로, 병후의 체력저하, 식욕부진, 영: This medicine is used as a nutritional tonic and for a weak constitution, physical fatigue, reduced physical strength after illness, loss of appetite, nutritional disorders, and febrile and wasting diseases.
entries.이 약은 정신적·신체적 기능무력 증상, 회복기간(아미노산 결핍상태) 동안: This medicine is used for symptoms of mental and physical asthenia and as supportive therapy during the recovery period (a state of amino acid deficiency).
entries.이 약은 진행성 지장각피증(주부습진의 건조형), 손·발바닥 각피증, 어린: This medicine is used for progressive keratoderma of the palms (the dry form of housewife's eczema), keratoderma of the palms and soles, ichthyosis, senile xerosis, keratosis pilaris, and atopic skin.
entries.이 약은 치육점막이 상승된 히알루론산 농도를 필요로 하는 치은염, 잇몸출: This medicine is used to treat inflammatory conditions such as gingivitis and bleeding gums, in which the gum mucosa requires an increased concentration of hyaluronic acid, and traumatic conditions such as those after scaling, stripping, tooth extraction, or surgical procedures.
entries.이 약은 치주(치아주위조직) 치료 후 치은염(잇몸염), 경·중등도 치주(: This medicine is used as supportive treatment for gingivitis (inflammation of the gums) after periodontal (tissue around the teeth) treatment and for mild to moderate periodontitis (inflammation of the tissue around the teeth).
entries.이 약은 코감기(급성비염), 알레르기성 비염 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘: This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold (acute rhinitis), allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코점막 분비물 또는 화농성 (곪음)으로 인한 코막힘에 코 안 세: This medicine is used for rinsing the inside of the nose in cases of nasal congestion caused by nasal mucous secretions or suppuration (festering), and to relieve dryness of the nasal mucosa.
entries.이 약은 피부, 창상면, 점막의 세정, 습포, 함소, 분무흡입제로서 점막: This medicine is used for cleansing the skin, wound surfaces, and mucous membranes, for wet compresses, for gargling, and, as a spray inhalation, for cleansing mucous membranes and promoting the expulsion of sputum, as well as for cleansing medical instruments.
entries.이 약은 필요 시 2~3시간마다 각 코 안에 뿌립니다.횟수는 연령에 따라: Spray this medicine into each nostril every 2 to 3 hours as needed. The number of sprays varies according to age. Insert the nozzle into the nostril and point its tip slightly backwards. Press the pump firmly to activate the spray, spray the specified amount into both nostrils, then tilt your head to the right for 10 seconds and then to the left for 10 seconds. After that, hold your nose with your hand to close the nostrils and bend your head forward for 10 seconds. Infants may be given 1 spray, those aged 1 month to 12 months 1 to 2 sprays, those aged 1 to 2 years 1 to 3 sprays, those aged 2 to 5 years 1 to 4 sprays, those aged 5 to 8 years 1 to 5 sprays, those aged 8 to 12 years 1 to 6 sprays, and adults 1 to 8 sprays.
Avoid using this medicine at the same time as other disinfectants.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 3개월 미만의 영아는 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십시: Before taking this medicine, infants under 3 months of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 임부 또는 임신하고 있다고 생각되는 사람은 의사: Before taking this medicine, women who are pregnant or think they may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제,: While taking this medicine, do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with antialdosterone agents or triamterene. Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take antitussives and expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 테트라사이클린, 디곡신, 플루오로퀴놀론, 철염(I: While taking this medicine, allow an interval of 2 hours between it and tetracycline, digoxin, fluoroquinolones, iron salts, ketoconazole, neuroleptics, thyroxine, penicillamine, beta blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, propranolol), glucocorticoids, chloroquine, estramustine, and diphosphonates.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안에는 다른 진토제, 감기약, 해열진통제, 항히스타민: While taking this medicine, do not take other antiemetics, cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, antihistamines, sedatives, antitussives and expectorants, or gastrointestinal analgesics and antispasmodics. Do not drink alcoholic beverages while taking this medicine.

Do not swallow this medicine.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 이 약에 알레르기 증상 경험자는 의사 또는 약사와: Before using this medicine, people who have experienced allergic symptoms to this medicine should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after several days of use, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for dental use only. Do not use the product after its expiry date. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약을 사용하는 동안 다른 두피용 약물, 외용 코르티코이드, 레티노이드: While using this medicine, do not use it together with other scalp medicines, topical corticoids, retinoids, petrolatum, dithranol, medicines known to promote absorption through the skin, or vasodilators such as guanethidine.
entries.이상반응, 체액과잉 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If adverse reactions or fluid overload occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파와 함께: Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.

If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it several times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. entries.질환부위가 곪아있는 사람, 심장질환, 고혈압, 갑상선질환, 당뇨병, 전립: People whose affected area is festering, patients with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating due to benign prostatic hyperplasia, breastfeeding women, and children under 7 years of age must not use this medicine. entries.테트라사이클린, 디곡신, 플루오로퀴놀론, 철염, 케토코나졸, 신경이완제,: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with tetracycline, digoxin, fluoroquinolones, iron salts, ketoconazole, neuroleptics, thyroxine, penicillamine, beta blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, propranolol), glucocorticoids, chloroquine, estramustine, or diphosphonates.
entries.통증, 시야변화, 지속적인 충혈이나 자극감 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉: If pain, changes in vision, or persistent redness or irritation occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
